# 0008: Human approval before the regression suite; exports generated by code

## Decision
Every test starts as `pending`. Only tests a person marks `approved` are exported. A test that errored cannot be approved (HTTP 409).

Exports are generated by code from the stored specs:
- a Postman collection (runs in Postman or Newman),
- a pytest file that runs without Verity installed,
- test cases as CSV (manual steps),
- bug reports as Jira CSV.

CI runs the exported pytest file and the Postman collection against both Shelf builds, so the exporters are tested end to end.

## Why
A wrong expected value in an approved test would fail forever or, worse, pass on a bug. Review is the point where a person checks the model's reading of the requirement.
